title: Michael is put in a machine like a shower stall

tellings.quote: I got into this machine. It's like a shower stall.

plain: In 1977, at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, an Air Force airman named Michael Johnson was put inside a machine that he says was "like a shower stall." Johnson is one of several Air Force veterans who say they were abducted by aliens while stationed there. He tells Michels about it as part of what he remembers of that experience.
